proof: For the all-zero target, querying $n-1$ zero coordinates leaves only the singleton on the remaining coordinate; fewer queries leave at least two singletons.  Any target having a positive coordinate is specified by that coordinate, while a target with at least two positive coordinates is excluded by querying two of them.  Thus, for $n\ge2$, the maximum is $n-1$.
name: Extended Teaching Dimension of Singletons
